# Tax Shark Inc.

> > Tax Shark Inc. provides practical guidance on tax strategies, estate planning, mortgage lending, and insurance coverage with detailed regulatory and compliance information.

The site offers comprehensive guides covering IRS tax regulations, estate planning tools like POD accounts, mortgage products from lenders like Rocket Mortgage, and insurance policy details under ISO standards. Content emphasizes federal and state-specific rules including FHA, VA, USDA loan programs, and regulations from agencies like the FDIC, CFPB, and Dodd-Frank Act provisions.

## Key Topics

- Payable on Death (POD) Accounts
- Estate Planning & Probate Avoidance
- FHA, VA, and USDA Loans
- FDIC Insurance
- IRS Tax Deductions & Credits
- Property Tax Portability
- Rocket Mortgage Products
- ISO Insurance Standards
- Uniform Probate Code
- Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)
- Agricultural Tax Exemptions
- Mortgage Lending Regulations
- Insurance Coverage Exclusions
- State-Specific Tax Rules (California, Texas, Florida)
- Dodd-Frank Act Compliance
